=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:574-576 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: In triage_release_download_rerun_gate, the jobs payload filter `.total_count == (.jobs | length) and .total_count < 100` rejects a complete page of exactly 100 jobs, even though the request uses per_page=100.
  WHY: A run with exactly 100 jobs logs `RELEASE_DOWNLOAD_RERUN outcome=skip reason=jobs_unreadable` and gets a triage issue instead of a re-run. The fix is `<= 100`. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said MAJOR, the others said NIT, so the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes it fails open to today's behaviour. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it as a deliberate truncation guard that fails open.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:496-497 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: In triage_release_download_classify, the annotations filter `length < 100` rejects a response of exactly 100 entries, even though the request uses per_page=100.
  WHY: A qualifying release-download failure in a full 100-entry response is classified as `not_release_download`, so triage files an issue instead of re-running the job. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said MAJOR, the others said NIT, so the highest is used. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes GitHub caps annotations per job well below 100, so this rarely triggers. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected it as a deliberate truncation guard that fails open.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:547-605 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The workflow_run path of triage_release_download_rerun_gate makes up to 5 reads before the rerun POST: 1 run GET, 1 `attempts/1/jobs` GET and up to 3 annotations GETs. The linked issue's §15 budget is "at most 2 reads and 1 write per triaged failure".
  WHY: Every triaged Actions failure with 3 failed jobs spends 5 GH_PAT reads, which adds pressure on the shared quota during outage bursts. The test pins `assertLessEqual(len(_annotation_gets(calls)), 3)` (tests/test_check_failure_triage_release_download_rerun.py:277) instead of 1, and neither the README, the agents.d fragment nor the changelog says the budget is exceeded.
- tests/test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py:840 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: _run_blocked_planning_step runs the step with `bash -c` and no strict shell flags (`set -euo pipefail`).
  WHY: Failing commands in the step, such as gh or jq errors, may be ignored silently, which can produce false-positive test passes. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this because the step body starts with `set -euo pipefail` (.github/workflows/plan.yml:2314) and the test runs `step["run"]` verbatim.
- Pull Request body:"Fixes #2734" | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR body uses an auto-close keyword against `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue #2734.
  WHY: Merging would auto-close the tracking issue and stop the orchestrator from dispatching waves, which violates CLAUDE.md §19 and unattended §21. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this: the `Fixes #2734` lines are fixture output from tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py, and the PR body says "Closes .../issues/9120".
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:621-633 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: triage_release_download_rerun_gate has no guard across invocations, so concurrent collect runs for sibling failed checks of the same workflow run can each POST `rerun-failed-jobs` (call site at line 1086).
  WHY: The second POST either logs `outcome=skip reason=rerun_failed` and files a triage issue for a run that is already re-running, or re-runs the same run twice. That contradicts the "each workflow run is re-run at most once" claim (scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:461-462). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this because Actions failures arrive as one workflow_run invocation per run.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:about line 575 (also about line 496) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: In triage_release_download_rerun_gate, the jobs filter `.total_count == (.jobs | length) and .total_count < 100` rejects a complete 100-job page, even though the request is `-f per_page=100`. The same off-by-one is in triage_release_download_classify (`length < 100`, about line 496).
  WHY: An attempt-1 run with exactly 100 jobs logs `RELEASE_DOWNLOAD_RERUN outcome=skip reason=jobs_unreadable` and gets a triage issue instead of a re-run. This fails open and is rare. The fix is `<= 100`.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:triage_release_download_rerun_gate workflow_run branch | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Before the POST, this path makes up to 5 reads: 1 run GET, 1 `attempts/1/jobs` GET and up to 3 `check-runs/${rd_id}/annotations` GETs. The issue's §15 budget is at most 2 reads and 1 write. test_base_gate_reuses_the_gate_run_read asserts `assertLessEqual(len(_annotation_gets(calls)), 3)` instead of 1.
  WHY: Every triaged Actions failure with 3 failed jobs spends 5 GH_PAT reads. Actions failures only arrive through workflow_run with `check_run_id: ""` (workflow-templates/ai-check-failure-triage.yml:48-53), and neither the agents.d fragment nor the changelog says the budget is above the approved limit.
- HARDENING: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:triage_release_download_rerun_gate. When the PR fetch fails, PR_JSON falls back to '{}' (lines 1030-1036), so the fork guard at line 1075 is skipped. Suggested fix: skip with `reason=pr_unverified` when `[ "${HEAD_REPO_FULL_NAME}" != "${REPO}" ]`, and add the reason to agents.d/9120-release-download-rerun.md. Also use `<= 100` in both places. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

  PROBLEM: The jq filters `length < 100` (annotations) and `.total_count < 100` (jobs) reject payloads with exactly 100 entries, even though the request uses `per_page=100`.
  WHY: Eligible jobs with exactly 100 entries fall back to standard triage instead of being re-run, which can trigger critical alerts for transient 5xx outages.
- tests/test_plan_clarify_blocked_output.py:840 (_run_blocked_planning_step) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The subprocess call uses `bash -c` without strict shell flags.
  WHY: Failing commands in the step may be ignored silently, which creates false-positive test passes.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:587 (triage_release_download_rerun_gate) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Allowing up to 3 failed jobs leads to up to 5 API reads (1 run, 1 jobs, 3 annotations) before the POST, which exceeds the budget of "at most 2 reads".
  WHY: This adds excessive pressure on the GitHub API quota during failure bursts.
- Pull Request body:"Fixes #2734" | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR body uses an auto-close keyword against `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue #2734.
  WHY: Merging would auto-close the tracking issue and stop orchestrator wave dispatch, which violates CLAUDE.md §19 and unattended §21.
- HARDENING: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:triage_release_download_rerun_gate. There is no fork/unverified-PR check when `HEAD_REPO_FULL_NAME` is unset or empty. Suggested fix: after the historical mode check, add an early `outcome=skip reason=pr_unverified` return when it is empty or `!= "${REPO}"`. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:lines 621-633 (POST block), call site at line 1086 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: triage_release_download_rerun_gate has no guard across invocations. Concurrent collect runs for 2-3 failed release-download checks of one workflow run can each POST `rerun-failed-jobs` (line 628).
  WHY: Only the first check to reach the POST meets the "re-runs once and files no issue" goal. Sibling checks get `outcome=skip reason=rerun_failed` and file issues, or the run is re-run twice, which contradicts scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:461-462.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:run GET (:547), jobs GET (:572), annotations GET loop (:597-605) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The workflow_run path makes up to 5 reads plus the POST, which exceeds the issue's "§15: at most 2 reads and 1 write per triaged failure". The test pins `assertLessEqual(len(_annotation_gets(calls)), 3)` (tests/test_check_failure_triage_release_download_rerun.py:277).
  WHY: During an outage burst, these reads fan out against the shared GH_PAT quota, and the deviation from the approved budget is not documented.
- HARDENING: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:triage_release_download_rerun_gate, before the annotations loop. A failed PR fetch leaves PR_JSON='{}' (line 1029-1031), so the fork guard at line 1075 does not fire. Suggested fix: return early with `outcome=skip reason=pr_unverified` when `[ -z "${HEAD_REPO_FULL_NAME}" ]`, and add the reason to agents.d/9120-release-download-rerun.md. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
